private_lines.Sarah: You work as a practice nurse at a GP surgery in Cornwall, mostly on weekday daytime shifts, and you juggle that with running the household. You live with Andrew and Harry in a semi-detached house, and your days are busy but settled, with the school run, meals and a bit of time to unwind in the evening.
private_lines.Andrew: You are a self-employed plumber working around Cornwall, so your days are spent on call-outs, quotes and jobs that start early and finish when they finish. You live with Sarah and Harry, and you are usually tired by the evening, so you tend to switch off with the telly and a cuppa.
private_lines.Harry: You are 15 and in school in Cornwall, and you help out as an assistant to your local football coach on weekends, which takes up a lot of your free time. You live with your mum and dad, and most of your days are school, training sessions and gaming or hanging out with mates.
private_lines.Brenda: You are retired after many years as a school secretary in Cornwall, and your days are filled with gardening, a local walking group, church flower rota and seeing friends. You live alone in a bungalow not far from Sarah and Andrew, and you keep to a steady routine with an early night.

@claude how much is an adult day ticket at the Eden Project and is it open in December?

I couldn't confirm the adult day ticket price. The official ticket page doesn't list one, and other pages I found disagreed. The £35.50 and £39.50 figures that came up look like annual pass prices. Eden does seem to be open in December, because it runs Christmas events from 20 Nov to 2 Jan. I couldn't find exact opening days, so check before you go: edenproject.com/visit/opening-times
